witness_description: n = 3 is a counterexample: λ = 1 and 2λ = 2, but the largest even number in {1,2,3,4} is 4.
refutation_explanation: For n = 3, λ = ⌈(3−1)/2⌉ = 1. Hence 2λ = 2, whereas n+1 = 4 is even and belongs to {1,2,…,n+1}, so 2λ is not the largest even number in that set.
search_space: All integer n from 2 through 64 inclusive were checked in increasing order using exact integer arithmetic; every even member of {1,2,…,n+1} was enumerated for each n.
